subject: Hospitality
title: The Plaza Hotel: New York's Grand Dame
description: A quick win: understand The Plaza Hotel: New York's Grand Dame.

hook.text: The Plaza Hotel opened in 1907 on Fifth Avenue, designed to resemble a French Renaissance château transplanted to Manhattan.

buildup.text: The building's 19 stories, copper mansard roof, and white brick façade became one of New York's most recognized landmarks.

discovery.text: The Plaza featured in films from 'Home Alone 2' to 'The Great Gatsby.' Its architecture is inseparable from New York's identity.

twist.text: In 2005, most of the Plaza was converted into condominiums. Only 282 of its original 805 rooms remain as hotel rooms.

climax.text: The Plaza proves that hotel architecture can outlive the hotel itself. The building's cultural value exceeds its room revenue.

punchline.text: A château on Fifth Avenue. The Plaza is more monument than hotel now.
